what: Wave 6 part A (ticket #75): the same rapid-click walk as demo-rapid-click.json, after the fix, from e2e/demo.spec.ts 'rapid clicks on Start and Next end at the last step...'
method: Raw element.click() on [data-testid=demo-next] every 50 ms with no waiting (a disabled button swallows a click as for a hand), at least 30 presses and until the strip reads 15/15; the strip's progress is sampled after each press (a step that finishes between two samples is not seen, so a missing number in the sequence is a sampling gap, not a skipped step). The guarded run is Reset, then one Next per step with a wait for 'n/15' each time. Ledger entries are read from the Ledger page after each walk.
before: demo-rapid-click.json: unguarded 15 presses stopped at step 6; a mash looped 1..7 four times and ended at step 2; a user who waited only for the spinner restarted after step 7 and ended at step 6.

wave6b_six_scene_story.what: Wave 6 part B (ticket #75): the same rapid-click walk and guarded walk on the eleven-step late-payment story (six scenes), from e2e/demo.spec.ts 'rapid clicks on Start and Next end at the last step...'
wave6b_six_scene_story.method: As above, with 'n/11'. The eighth step's button is the owner's approval, so the rapid walk approves the cure by pressing it (a hand that fast has decided); the guarded walk presses it once. Ledger entries are read from the Ledger page after each walk, and the test also checks there is exactly one RECEIVE_PAYMENT.
wave6b_six_scene_story.reading: Both walks end at 11/11, never idle, never back, and leave the same ledger (live: the deal's two entries, three clock moves, the receipt, the queued and the approved cure). The steps are convergent, so no step ran twice.
